admission.justification: Realized across tags_engine.py (QualifierSpec) and extents.py (_enclosed_qualified_spans), and guarded by table-driven per-language qualifier and honest-refusal proofs.

applicability: Qualified symbol lookup across non-exact-binding tree-sitter languages in tags_engine.QualifierSpec and extents._enclosed_qualified_spans.
conditions: Each language declares its native container separators and optional separatorKinds filters in QualifierSpec (empty separators for flat languages such as C and Bash).

_enclosed_qualified_spans splits longest-match-first on configured separators, enforces separatorKinds filters, matches explicit @container capture chains and nested lexical enclosure, and returns empty for flat languages or unresolved qualified names.
exclusions: Exact-binding providers such as built-in Lean (uses_exact_bindings=True) resolve exact whole/full keys only under INV-XA55TP and INV-0KYRK9.
statement: Qualified symbol resolution follows each language's explicit declarative QualifierSpec (dot scope and Go receiver Type.Method, :: for Rust and C++, #/./:: kind-filtered scope for Ruby, \/::/. for PHP, and explicit container captures for extensions/schemas/HCL blocks) and honestly refuses flat-language qualifiers (C, Bash) and unresolved qualified names.
title: Declarative per-language QualifierSpec resolves qualifiers or honestly refuses
